# Fortera Homes

> Ottawa builder and developer of multiplexes and purpose-built rentals, serving Ottawa and the surrounding region. For multiplex clients Fortera manages the whole project, from land and zoning through permits, construction financing and construction, and hands over a finished building ready for long-term financing. Its Beechwood Collection rentals are now leasing.

## Services

- **Multiplexes:** triplexes, fourplexes and low-rise rental buildings. Fortera manages feasibility, Committee of Adjustment applications, permits, construction financing and the build, then hands the building over, planned for long-term financing such as CMHC MLI Select. Fortera prepares the financing package and works with the client's lender or broker to secure it. https://forterahomes.ca/services/multiplexes
- **Service area:** Ottawa and the surrounding region.
- **Experience:** backed by 25 years of construction experience.

# Beechwood Collection

New two bedroom rental apartments in Beechwood, Ottawa. Now leasing at 82 Genest St (Beechwood South), from $2,300/month, with move-ins early 2027.

Beechwood Collection by Fortera Homes is a new 8-unit purpose-built rental building at 82 Genest St in Ottawa's Beechwood South neighbourhood. Every suite is a two bedroom home of 860 to 920 sq ft, with one or two full bathrooms depending on the floor. Suites include in-suite laundry, high ceilings, premium finishes, and a private balcony or patio. The building is now leasing ahead of its early 2027 completion.

## The Development

- **Project name:** Beechwood Collection
- **Developer / landlord:** Fortera Homes
- **Address:** 82 Genest St, Ottawa, ON, Canada
- **Neighbourhood:** Beechwood South, Ottawa (at the edge of New Edinburgh)
- **Units:** 8 rental suites, all two bedroom
- **Size range:** 860 to 920 sq ft
- **Rent:** $2,300 to $2,600 per month
- **Status:** Now leasing
- **Estimated move-in:** Early 2027
- **Lease terms offered:** 1 year, 2 years, or 3 years or more

## Floor Plans & Rent

- **Mackay A / Mackay B**: 2 bed / 1 bath, 860 sq ft, ground floor (units 101, 102), $2,300/month
- **Manor A / Manor B**: 2 bed / 2 bath, 920 sq ft, 2nd and 3rd floor (units 201, 202, 301, 302), $2,500/month
- **Rideau A / Rideau B**: 2 bed / 2 bath, 920 sq ft, 4th (top) floor (units 401, 402), $2,600/month

Floor plans for every unit are on the project page: https://forterahomes.ca/projects/beechwood-collection

## Included in Every Suite

- In-suite washer and dryer
- High ceilings and large windows
- Premium kitchen finishes
- Private balcony or patio
- Internet included (Bell Fiber, over 1 Gbps) for leases signed on or before December 31, 2026, a $110/month value
- Keyless entry
- HRV ventilation and smart thermostats
- Sound insulation and energy-efficient building systems
- Dedicated storage units and bicycle storage
- Fully accessible units available

## How to Apply

1. Apply online at https://forterahomes.ca/register?type=rent (about one minute).
2. The Fortera team follows up with availability and answers to questions.
3. Approved applicants choose their floor and unit. Screening includes a credit check plus rental history, income, and references.

## Location & Neighbourhood

82 Genest St is in Beechwood South, one of Ottawa's most walkable and bikeable neighbourhoods, a short walk from the cafés and shops on Beechwood Avenue.

- **Walk Score:** 94 (Walker's Paradise)
- **Transit Score:** 58 (Good Transit, OC Transpo)
- **Bike Score:** 99 (Biker's Paradise)
- About a 2 minute walk to the Ottawa River Pathway
- Minutes from Beechwood Cemetery's 160 acres of walking trails
- OC Transpo bus service into downtown Ottawa

## Multiplexes & CMHC MLI Select

Fortera Homes builds multiplexes and small apartment buildings for landowners and investors in Ottawa and the surrounding region, managing approvals, permits, construction and handover. The team has hands-on experience with CMHC financing for rental buildings, including MLI Select, and plans each building around a target points score from the feasibility stage. Fortera prepares the financing package and works with the client's lender or broker to secure it.

- CMHC MLI Select requires at least 5 units and 50 points. Points come from affordability (10% / 15% / 25% of units at or below 30% of median renter income = 50 / 70 / 100 points; +30 for a 20-year commitment), energy efficiency (20 / 35 / 50 points) and accessibility (20 / 30 points).
- New construction: up to 95% loan-to-cost; amortization up to 40 years (50 pts), 45 years (70 pts) or 50 years (100 pts); premium discount of 10% / 20% / 30%; minimum DCR 1.10.
- Multiplexes page: https://forterahomes.ca/services/multiplexes

## About Fortera Homes

Fortera Homes is an Ottawa builder and developer backed by 25 years of construction experience. It builds and holds its own purpose-built rental collections and builds multiplexes for clients, managing each project from land to keys.
